courses.name: Bachelor of Pharmacy
courses.eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology / Mathematics
courses.feeNote: Tamil Nadu Selection Committee, govt-quota seat in self-financing college (2025-26). Management quota is set by each college.

courses.name: Doctor of Pharmacy
courses.eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology / Mathematics
courses.feeNote: Tamil Nadu Selection Committee, govt-quota seat in self-financing college (2026 prospectus: Rs 2,00,000 tuition + other fees). Management quota is higher.

courses.name: Master of Pharmacy
courses.eligibility: B.Pharm degree from a recognised university
courses.entranceExam: Tamil Nadu Selection Committee M.Pharm entrance exam (GPAT not required for state quota)
courses.feeNote: Tamil Nadu Selection Committee, govt-quota seat in self-financing college (2025-26). Management quota is set by each college.
